source: Spartacus GLADIATOR ARENA art-direction feedback 2026-10-20 and 2026-10-21

optionalMotionRules.roarMeaning: special intimidation or vocalization, NEVER substitute for guard

rules.description: Keep approved face, costume, proportions and weapon/armor appearance across every frame
rules.action: Compare contact sheets with approved source visually before release

rules.description: One character, exactly one motion, eight sequential key poses; no mixed-action boards
No duplicated silhouettes, ghost limbs, multiple monsters in one frame
rules.action: Fail ambiguous merged components and request re-generation

rules.description: Preserve only the current frame's own actor, including valid detached parts. Any head, foot, tail, torso or other body from an adjacent frame is FOREIGN and must be removed, regardless of pixel size or anatomical completeness.
rules.action: Detect frame provenance by comparing source sheet/neighbor exports. Remove verified neighboring-owned regions even when large. Never auto erase current-owned limbs. Unprovable overlaps block release.

rules.description: Foreign ownership ALWAYS overrides small-speck/large-body thresholds. A large neighbor body fragment must be deleted; a small current-owned limb must stay.
rules.action: Compare current-frame regions against both adjacent poses in source coordinates; erase pixel-proven foreign fragments, record mask and proof, require visual QA for glued or ambiguous body pieces.

rules.description: If a body region touches another pose and its ownership cannot be proved, never release it as clean and never silently amputate it.
rules.action: Automatically retry/regenerate the failed action (all eight poses) with specific pixel-ownership error feedback, then re-extract, QC, and preview; repeat for up to three configured retries. If no provider is connected, leave executable job QUEUED rather than claiming completion. Ask the user only when cause remains unresolved after retrial.

rules.description: Any generation or cutting QC failure automatically invokes regeneration for the SAME action: 8 clean native frames, known error diagnosis, isolated cuts, re-QA and before/after 8-frame PNG/GIF review.
rules.action: Each retry's job must carry exact failing frame numbers and error codes. Never mark ready without technical pass; avoid user questions for known errors and only escalate persistent unknown root causes. Keep old approved art until full animation/game QA pass.

rules.description: Keep full tails, claws, helmets, shields and weapons inside enlarged X and Y gutters
rules.action: Widen source frame canvas instead of shrinking artwork

rules.description: Same scale across all eight frames; anchor stable feet
rules.action: Use stable planted feet, never per-frame recenter or zoom

rules.description: Attack anticipation and advance, recoil backward, leap arc; no accidental frame bobbing
rules.action: Render animation GIF with frame DX/DY and inspect displacement

rules.description: Guard required; roar extra, not replacement
Card preview uses idle animation, never separate still thumbnail
rules.action: Use 8-frame idle canvas with no still art

rules.description: Selected card may play roar once; standoff may play roar with cooldown if actual art exists
rules.action: Never fake roar by reusing an attack pose

rules.description: Death plays all 8 frames and holds last frame
Do not replace approved production sprites without full coverage and browser validation
rules.action: Preserve old manifest until safe deployment

automaticRecovery.retryScope: one creature, one motion, eight complete frames
automaticRecovery.userInterruptionPolicy: Solve reproducible diagnosed issues automatically; escalate only after repeated unresolved or unknown-root-cause failures.
automaticRecovery.releaseGate: 8/8 QA + visual review + in-game browser playback before replacing production
